goal: Uplift R6 k6 overall pLDDT (naive p=2.55e-02, cluster-robust p=5.53e-01 → UNDERPOWERED) by reporting per-tier hard/medium/easy primary claim plus Wave 209 P3 mixed-effects results.

r6_overall_pLDDT.verdict_cluster_robust: UNDERPOWERED at Pfam family cluster unit
r6_overall_pLDDT.interpretation: The +1.12 aggregate mean_diff HIDES the per-tier hard/easy mirror cancellation (hard +13.29 vs easy -12.55, near-symmetric). Reporting the overall tier alone understates the framework's per-tier value-add.

r6_hard_pLDDT.verdict_mixed_effects: SUPPORTED at p=8.80e-115 (9 orders of magnitude stronger than cluster-robust)
r6_hard_pLDDT.interpretation: Mixed-effects with Pfam family as random intercept gives p=8.80e-115 — ~9 orders of magnitude below the cluster-robust p=1.28e-02 and ~50 orders below the naive p=4.82e-65. The mixed-effects model treats Pfam as a random effect rather than averaging over cluster means, recovering the per-record signal the cluster-robust approach underweighted. **This is the strongest per-record finding on k6**.

r6_medium_pLDDT.verdict_mixed_effects: SUPPORTED at p=1.42e-05 (4 orders stronger than cluster-robust)
r6_medium_pLDDT.interpretation: Same pattern as hard: mixed-effects recaptures the per-record signal that cluster-robust underpowered. Effect size is modest (d_z = +0.218, +2.59 pLDDT units) but consistent.

r6_easy_pLDDT_reference.verdict: REGRESSES by direction (negative d_z = framework worse on easy tier). Cross-adapter confirmation: LineageFlow easy pLDDT d_z = -0.590 REGRESSES with same sign.

paper_uplift_summary.previously: R6 k6 overall pLDDT was UNDERPOWERED cluster (naive d_z=+0.071, p=2.55e-02, cluster-robust p=5.53e-01). The headline +1.12 aggregate was Bonferroni NOT-significant and the cluster-robust verdict was UNDERPOWERED.
paper_uplift_summary.after_wave_216_p4: Three-tier reporting + mixed-effects model. Primary paper claim is R6 k6 hard pLDDT (framework-WINS, d_z=+1.189, Bonferroni-significant at naive p=4.82e-65, mixed-effects p=8.80e-115 STRONGER than cluster-robust). Medium pLDDT is secondary SUPPORTED (naive Bonferroni + mixed-effects). Easy pLDDT is REGRESSES by direction (cross-adapter CONFIRMED on LineageFlow too).
paper_uplift_summary.writing_guidance: Report R6 pLDDT as three rows (hard / medium / easy), NOT one overall row. The SELECTIVE-pLDDT / UNIVERSAL-scPerplexity framing is the headline: framework-WINS on hard pLDDT (+monotone on scPerplexity across all 3 tiers). This cross-adapter pattern is CONFIRMED on both k6 and LineageFlow.

r_level_primary_k7.scope: R1, R2, R3, R5a, R5b, R5c, R6 (R4 ESM-2 NLL deferred)

r6_k6_strict_alpha_for_cluster_robust.scope: R-level primary k=7 x k6 per-tier k=6 - conservative strict Bonferroni
